choose.when: # 01 = 잠재고객 조회 SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM potential_customer WHERE id = #{customerId}

mapper.select: SELECT pc.id AS customerId, pc.name AS childName, pc.gender AS childGender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS childAge, pc.birth_date AS childBirthDate, pc.consult_status_code AS consultStatusCode, consult.code_name AS consultStatusName, pc.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, conversion.code_name AS conversionStatusName, NULL AS reportUrl, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN '01' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '02' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 14 AND 20 THEN '03' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 21 THEN '04' END AS lifeStageCode, lifecycle.code_name AS lifeStageName, CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(pc.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) < CURDATE() THEN DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(pc.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL 1 YEAR ) ELSE STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(pc.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) END AS insuranceAgeShiftDate, parent.integrated_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, parent.name AS guardianName, pc.relationship_code AS relationshipCode, relationship.code_name AS relationshipName, parent.phone AS guardianPhone, parent.address AS guardianAddress, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, parent.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS guardianAge FROM potential_customer pc INNER JOIN integrated_customer parent ON parent.integrated_customer_id = pc.parent_customer_id LEFT JOIN common_code consult ON consult.group_code = 'CONSULT_STATUS' AND consult.code_value = pc.consult_status_code LEFT JOIN common_code conversion ON conversion.group_code = 'CONVERSION_STATUS' AND conversion.code_value = pc.conversion_status_code LEFT JOIN common_code relationship ON relationship.group_code = 'RELATIONSHIP' AND relationship.code_value = pc.relationship_code LEFT JOIN common_code lifecycle ON lifecycle.group_code = 'LIFECYCLE' AND lifecycle.code_value = CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN '01' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '02' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 14 AND 20 THEN '03' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pc.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 21 THEN '04' END WHERE pc.id = #{customerId} AND pc.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId}

SELECT child.integrated_customer_id AS customerId, child.name AS childName, child.gender AS childGender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS childAge, child.birth_date AS childBirthDate, NULL AS consultStatusCode, NULL AS consultStatusName, '02' AS conversionStatusCode, conversion.code_name AS conversionStatusName, NULL AS reportUrl, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN '01' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '02' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 14 AND 20 THEN '03' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 21 THEN '04' END AS lifeStageCode, lifecycle.code_name AS lifeStageName, CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(child.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) < CURDATE() THEN DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(child.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ), INTERVAL 1 YEAR ) ELSE STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT( YEAR(CURDATE()), '-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(child.birth_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH), '%m-%d') ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) END AS insuranceAgeShiftDate, parent.integrated_customer_id AS parentCustomerId, parent.name AS guardianName, CASE WHEN parent.gender = 'MALE' THEN '01' WHEN parent.gender = 'FEMALE' THEN '02' END AS relationshipCode, relationship.code_name AS relationshipName, parent.phone AS guardianPhone, parent.address AS guardianAddress, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, parent.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS guardianAge FROM integrated_customer child LEFT JOIN integrated_customer parent ON parent.integrated_customer_id = child.parent_id LEFT JOIN common_code conversion ON conversion.group_code = 'CONVERSION_STATUS' AND conversion.code_value = '02' LEFT JOIN common_code lifecycle ON lifecycle.group_code = 'LIFECYCLE' AND lifecycle.code_value = CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN '01' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN '02' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 14 AND 20 THEN '03' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, child.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 21 THEN '04' END LEFT JOIN common_code relationship ON relationship.group_code = 'RELATIONSHIP' AND relationship.code_value = CASE WHEN parent.gender = 'MALE' THEN '01' WHEN parent.gender = 'FEMALE' THEN '02' END WHERE child.integrated_customer_id = #{customerId} AND child.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId}

SELECT DISTINCT dai.trigger_type_code AS code, trigger_code.code_name AS name FROM daily_action_item dai INNER JOIN common_code trigger_code ON trigger_code.group_code = 'TRIGGER_TYPE' AND trigger_code.code_value = dai.trigger_type_code WHERE dai.customer_id = #{customerId} AND dai.conversion_status_code = #{conversionStatusCode} AND dai.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND dai.is_completed = FALSE AND dai.trigger_type_code IN ('06', '07', '08') ORDER BY dai.trigger_type_code
